data_points.notes: Korean domestic deodorant market 637억원 (KRW 63.7bn) in 2018, up from 593억원 (KRW 59.3bn) in 2017; figures attributed by the article to Euromonitor International's Beauty & Personal Care analysis. ~USD 43.1mn @ USD/KRW 1478.40 pinned 2026-07-21. SCOPE CAVEAT: domestic RETAIL sell-through, not export FOB or MFDS production value. STALE VINTAGE: 2018 is the most recent Korean-language figure that could be verified on a fetched page; no newer primary figure located. cf Actual Market Research >USD 160mn (2023) — 3.7x higher on a USD basis, definitional mismatch unresolved, do not average.

Article states the Korean deodorant market recorded growth 'in the 7% range' (7%대의 성장률) moving from 593억원 (2017) to 637억원 (2018); implied arithmetic growth is 7.4%. Attributed to Euromonitor. STALE VINTAGE: 2018. Growth is on domestic RETAIL value in KRW.

Stated as 'valued at more than USD 160 Million in 2023' — a floor, not a point estimate. Value basis not stated by source; assumed consumer sell-through. cf Euromonitor-via-Pharm News KRW 63.7bn (2018) = ~USD 43mn — 3.7x gap, definitional mismatch unresolved (aggregator scope may include antiperspirant/body-mist adjacencies), do not average. Statista Consumer Market Outlook reportedly shows US$41.42mn for 2025 but all figures on the Statista page are masked behind a paywall, so not claimed.

Category leader share: 'Deodorants in South Korea in 2025 remained highly concentrated' with 'Beiersdorf Korea Ltd (Nivea) holding a commanding share of 59%'. Text verified on the fetched Euromonitor report-overview page; the underlying value figures on that page are paywalled. Highly concentrated category structure is the key entry-barrier read for this segment.
